sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (96 marks)
items: 1. Name the parts of the eye labelled in the diagram and state the function of each. (6 marks)
2. Explain the difference between mitosis and meiosis. (4 marks)
3. Define the terms gene, allele and genotype. (3 marks)
4. State two functions of the kidney in the human body. (2 marks)
5. Describe how insulin regulates the level of sugar in the blood. (4 marks)
